posts.post_caption:
The Dog Stars is coming home! 

Peter Heller’s novel is now a Ridley Scott-directed film, and the story of pilot Hig surviving in a post-pandemic, apocalyptic Delta County, with his dog and a 1956 Cessna, will be showing at The Paradise October 23, 24, and 25. 

Peter will be giving a talk-back after the show on the 23rd. 
Paonia Literary Project will give away signed copies of The Dogs Stars novel to the first 40 attendees at matinee showings on October 24 and 25. 

Tickets are $10 and available only at the Paradise, online and in person. 

Showtimes: 
Friday, October 23 at 6.30, doors at 6 pm. 
Saturday, October 24 at 2:00pm, doors at 1.30
Sunday, October 25 at 2:00 pm, doors at 1.30.

https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/ticketing/paonia-literary-club-presents-the-dog-stars
